4.text: VOLUNTARY DEATH. — Voluntary death is still of frequent occurrence

5.text: among the Chukchee. It is inflicted by a friend or relative, upon the expressed

6.text: wish of the person who desires to die. Though I had no occasion to witness

7.text: a case of voluntary death, I know of about twenty cases which happened

14.text: From what has been related, it will be seen that the voluntary death of

15.text: old men is not prompted by any lack of good feeling towards the old men,

16.text: but rather by the hard conditions of their life, which make existence almost

17.text: unendurable for any one unable to take full care of himself. Accordingly,

18.text: not only old people, but also those afflicted by some illness, often prefer death

19.text: to continued suffering; and their number is even greater than that of old

20.text: people who die a voluntary death.

21.text: The position of an infirm man among the Chukchee is very hard indeed,
